questions.question: What did Jehoshaphat do when Moab and Ammon came against Judah?
options: Proclaimed a fast and sought the LORD
Surrendered all of Judah to the invaders
Fled the city with his household
questions.answer: Proclaimed a fast and sought the LORD

questions.question: What did Jahaziel say about the battle?
options: Run away long before the armies meet
The battle is not yours but God's
Wait a year before going out
questions.answer: The battle is not yours but God's

questions.question: Judah won by sending singers ahead to praise the LORD, and the enemies destroyed one another.
Jehoshaphat said, 'Believe in the LORD your God, and you will be _____.'
They gathered the spoil for three days and assembled in the Valley of _____ to bless the LORD.
